Assignment Title: Smart Home System

Assignment Question:
Develop a Java program to implement a Smart Home System using Multilevel Inheritance.
Create the following three classes:
1. Device – Base Class
Include the data member: deviceId (String)
The class should contain:
- A parameterized constructor to initialize deviceId.
- Any additional method, if required.
2. SmartDevice – Intermediate Class
Inherit from the Device class.
Include the following additional data member:
- powerConsumption (int)
The class should contain:
- A parameterized constructor to initialize all the inherited and its own data members using super().
- A method calculatePowerCost() to calculate the daily power cost.
- Any additional methods, if required.
Use the formula:
Daily Power Cost = Power Consumption × Electricity Rate
Assume the electricity rate is Rs.8 per unit.
3. SmartAC – Derived Class
Inherit from the SmartDevice class.
Include the following additional data members:
- energySavingMode (boolean)
The class should contain:
- A parameterized constructor to initialize all the data members.
- A method displayACDetails() to display the complete AC details.
- If energySavingMode is "true", provide a 10% discount on the calculated daily power cost.
The program should create a SmartAC object using a parameterized constructor and display the device ID, power consumption, energy-saving mode, original daily power cost, discount amount, and final daily power cost.
Sample Input
I101 (Device ID)
10 (Power Consumption in units)
true (Energy Saving Mode (true/false))
Sample Output
Device ID: I101
Power Consumption: 10.0 units
Electricity Rate: 8.0 per unit
Energy Saving Mode: true
Original Daily Power Cost: 80.0
Energy Saving Discount: 8.0
Final Daily Power Cost: 72.0
